question:
The kilovoltage applied to an X-ray tube affects:
엑스선관에 적용한 전압은 무엇에 영향을 주는가?
options: A. the quality of the beam (빔의 질)
B. the intensity of the beam (빔의 강도)
C. both A and B above (위 A, B 모두)
D. neither A nor B above (위 A, B 모두 아니다)

question:
A good cobalt-60 radiograph is made on a 3 inch steel casting using an exposure time of 10 minutes and a source to film distance of 36 inches. If it is necessary to change the source to film distance to 24 inches, what exposure time would produce a similar radiograph if all other conditions remain the same?
Co-60 선원으로 36인치 거리에서 10분 노출한 경우, 거리를 24인치로 변경했을 때 동일한 사진을 얻기 위한 노출 시간은?
options: A. 1.6 minutes (1.6분)
B. 4.4 minutes (4.4분)
C. 6.4 minutes (6.4분)
D. 8.8 minutes (8.8분)

question:
When sharp black bird-foot shaped marks which are known not to correspond with any discontinuities appear at random on radiographs, they are probably caused by:
불연속과 관계없는 날카롭고 검은 새 발가락 모양의 표시가 방사선 사진에 무질서하게 나타나는 원인은?
options: A. prolonged development in old developer (오래된 현상액에서 장시간 현상)
B. exposure of the film by natural cosmic ray showers during storage (보관 중 자연 우주선 노출)
C. static charges caused by friction (마찰에 의한 정전기)
D. inadequate rinsing after fixing (정착 후 불충분한 세척)

question:
In comparison with lower-voltage radiography, high-energy radiography show:
낮은 전압 방사선 사진과 비교하여 고에너지 방사선 사진은?
options: A. greater contrast (높은 명암도)
B. greater latitude (높은 허용도)
C. greater amounts of scatter radiation relative to primary beam intensity (일차 빔 대비 산란 방사선 증가)
D. none of the above (해당 없음)

question:
Filters used at the port of the X-ray tube:
엑스선관의 필터는?
options: A. intensity the X-ray beam by contributing secondary radiation (2차 방사선으로 빔 강도를 증가)
B. filter short wavelength X-ray beams to provide softer radiation (짧은 파장을 제거하여 연한 방사선 생성)
C. provide the most readily adjusted means of modifying X-ray intensity (X선 강도 조절 수단 제공)
D. filter out soft radiation to provide a more homogeneous X-ray beam (연한 방사선을 제거하여 균일한 빔 생성)

question:
An ACME Pentameter for use when inspecting a one-half inch thick steel plate to the 2-2T quality level using a 15inch source-to-film distance would be made of:
15인치 선원-필름 거리에서 1/2인치 철판을 2-2T 품질 수준으로 검사할 때 투과도계 재질은?
options: A. 5 mil thick aluminum (5mil 알루미늄)
B. 50 mil thick aluminum or steel (50mil 알루미늄 또는 철)
C. 10 mil thick steel (10mil 철)
D. 2 mil strip of any metallic material (2mil 금속 스트립)

question:
Filters placed between the X-ray tube and specimen tend to reduce scatter radiation:
엑스선관과 시험물 사이의 필터는 산란 방사선을 어떻게 감소시키는가?
options: A. by absorbing the longer wavelength components of the primary beam (일차 빔의 긴 파장 성분 흡수)
B. by absorbing the shorter wavelength components of the primary beam (일차 빔의 짧은 파장 성분 흡수)
C. by absorbing backscatter radiation (후방 산란 흡수)
D. by decreasing the intensity of the beam (빔 강도 감소)

question:
Besides serving as a filter, screens of high atomic number such as lead and lead antimony also:
납과 같은 높은 원자번호 스크린은 필터 기능 외에 무엇을 하는가?
options: A. decrease the source to-film distance needed for proper radiography (필요 거리 감소)
B. provide some image intensifying action (상 감도 증가)
C. permit the use of higher speed film (고속 필름 사용 가능)
D. decrease graininess in a radiograph (입도 감소)

question:
The range of thickness over which densities are obtained that are satisfactory for interpretation is a measure of the:
해석 가능한 만족스러운 농도를 얻는 두께 범위는 무엇의 측정인가?
options: A. subject contrast of a radiograph (시험물 명암도)
B. sensitivity of a radiograph (방사선 감도)
C. latitude of a radiograph (방사선 허용도)
D. definition of a radiograph (선명도)

question:
Gamma ray source used mainly in NDT is:
NDT에서 주로 사용하는 감마선원은?
options: A. natural isotopes (천연 동위원소)
B. Iridium-192 or cobalt-60 (Ir-192 또는 Co-60)
C. Radium (라듐)
D. Thulium-170 (Tm-170)

question:
The gamma-ray intensity at one foot from a one curie source of radioactive cobalt-60 is nearest:
1Ci Co-60 선원으로부터 1피트 거리에서 감마선 강도는?
options: A. 15 roentgens per hour (15R/h)
B. 1000 roentgens per hour (1000R/h)
C. 1 roentgen per minute (1R/min)
D. 10 milliroentgens per hour (10mR/h)

question:
In an X-ray tube, the filament and focusing cup are the two essential parts of the:
X선관에서 필라멘트와 포커싱 컵은 무엇의 주요 부분인가?
options: A. anode (양극)
B. cathode (음극)
C. rectifier (정류기)
D. X-ray transformer (X선 변압기)

question:
The quantity of radiation which will produce, by means of ionization one electrostatic unit of electricity in 0.001293 grams of dry air is known as:
0.001293g의 건조 공기에서 이온화로 1 정전 단위의 전기를 만드는 방사선량은?
options: A. 1 millicurie (1mCi)
B. 1 gamma (1γ)
C. 1 roentgen (1R)
D. 1 curie (1Ci)

question:
Which of the following isotopes has the longest half-life?
다음 동위원소 중 반감기가 가장 긴 것은?
options: A. Thulium-170 (Tm-170)
B. Cobalt-60 (Co-60)
C. Iridium-192 (Ir-192)
D. Cesium-137 (Cs-137)

question:
The primary form of energy conversion when electrons strike a target in an X-ray tube results in the production of:
전자가 X선관 표적에 충돌할 때 최초 에너지 변환 결과는?
options: A. primary X-ray (1차 X선)
B. secondary X-rays (2차 X선)
C. short wavelength X-rays (짧은 파장 X선)
D. heat (열)

question:
An X-ray film having wide latitude also has, by definition:
허용도가 넓은 X선 필름은 정의상 무엇을 가지는가?
options: A. poor definition (낮은 선명도)
B. low contrast (낮은 명암도)
C. high speed (높은 속도)
D. none of the above (해당 없음)

question:
An X-ray tube with small focal spot is considered better than one with a large focal spot when it is desired to obtain:
작은 초점 X선관이 큰 초점보다 유리한 경우는?
options: A. greater penetrating power (높은 투과력)
B. better definition (좋은 선명도)
C. less contrast (낮은 명암도)
D. greater film density (높은 필름 농도)

question:
One method of reducing radiographic contrast is to:
방사선 사진의 명암도를 감소시키는 방법은?
options: A. increase the distance between radiation source and object (선원과 시험물 거리 증가)
B. decrease the distance between object and film (시험물과 필름 거리 감소)
C. decrease the wavelength of radiation used (사용 방사선 파장 감소)
D. increase development time within recommendations (현상 시간 증가)

question:
An X-ray tube is rated for a maximum of 250 KVP. This tube may be operated at a maximum of:
최대 250KVP로 정격된 X선관의 최대 작동 전압은?
options: A. 250,000 volts peak voltage (250,000V 피크 전압)
B. 250 KV effective voltage (250KV 유효 전압)
C. 250,000,000 volts rms voltage (250,000,000V RMS)
D. 250 KV average voltage (250KV 평균 전압)

question:
When radiographing to the 2-2T quality level an ASME penetrameter for 2.5 inch steel has a thickness of:
ASME 2-2T 기준에서 2.5인치 철판용 투과도계 두께는?
options: A. one half inch (1/2 inch)
B. 2.5 mils (0.0025 inch)
C. 5 mils (0.005 inch)
D. 50 mils (0.05 inch)

question:
The most common way of cooling the anode of a high-power X-ray tube is:
고출력 X선관의 양극을 냉각시키는 가장 일반적인 방법은?
options: A. cooling by radiation (열 복사 냉각)
B. cooling by means of circulating cooled air (순환 냉각 공기)
C. cooling by means of external fanned radiators (외부 방열기)
D. cooling by circulation of water or oil in the anode (양극 내부 물 또는 오일 순환)

question:
In certain cases, it may be advantageous to pack lead shot around a specimen. The purpose for doing this is:
시험물 주위에 납 입자를 채우는 목적은?
options: A. to prevent movement of the specimen (시험물 이동 방지)
B. to increase the subject contrast (시험물 명암도 증가)
C. to generate smaller wavelength X-radiation (짧은 파장 X선 생성)
D. to decrease the effect of scattered radiation undercutting the specimen (산란 방사선에 의한 언더컷 감소)

question:
Of the following, the source providing the most penetrating radiation is:
다음 중 가장 높은 투과력을 가진 방사선원은?
options: A. Cobalt-60 (Co-60)
B. 220 KVP X-ray tube (220KVP X선 발생장치)
C. 15 MeV X-ray betatron (15MeV X선 베타트론)
D. electrons from iridium-192 (Ir-192 전자)

question:
Low voltage X-ray tubes are generally fitted with windows made of:
저전압 X선관의 창 재질은?
options: A. Plastic (플라스틱)
B. Glass (유리)
C. Beryllium (베릴륨)
D. Lead (납)

question:
The general method of producing X-rays involves the sudden deceleration of high velocity electrons in a solid body called a:
고속 전자가 고체 물질에서 급격히 감속될 때 X선을 발생시키는 부분은?
options: A. focus cup (포커스 컵)
B. filament (필라멘트)
C. target (표적)
D. cathode (음극)

question:
If it were necessary to radiograph a 7 inch thick steel product which gamma-ray source would likely be used?
7인치 두께 철 제품 촬영 시 적합한 감마선원은?
options: A. Cobalt-60 (Co-60)
B. Thulium-170 (Tm-170)
C. Iridium-192 (Ir-192)
D. Cesium-137 (Cs-137)

question:
A cobalt-60 gamma-ray source has an approximate practical thickness limit of:
Co-60 감마선원의 실제 사용 가능한 두께 한계는?
options: A. 2 1/2 inches of steel or equivalent
B. 4 inches of steel or equivalent
C. 9 inches of steel or equivalent
D. 11 inches of steel or equivalent

question:
The uneven distribution of developed grains within the emulsion of a processed X-ray film causes the subjective impression of:
현상된 X선 필름 유제 내 불균일한 입자 분포로 발생하는 현상은?
options: A. graininess (입도)
B. streaks (줄무늬)
C. spots (반점)
D. white scum (흰 얼룩)

question: Cobalt-60 has a half-life of 5.3 years. By how much should exposure time be increased when the source is two years old?
options: A. No change in exposure time is needed
B. About 11 percent longer
C. About 31 percent longer
D. About 62 to 100 percent longer

question: An Iridium-192 source with a half-life of 75 days provides an optimum exposure of 20 minutes today. Five months later, what exposure time would be required?
options: A. 10 minutes
B. 20 minutes
C. 1 hour and 20 minutes
D. 6 hours

question:
Images of discontinuities close to the source side of the specimen become less clearly defined as:
시험물의 선원쪽 표면에 있는 불연속 영상의 선명도가 감소하는 경우는?
options: A. source to object distance increases (선원과 시험물 거리 증가)
B. the thickness of the specimen increases (시험물 두께 증가)
C. the size of the focal spot decreases (초점 크기 감소)
D. the thickness of the specimen decreases (시험물 두께 감소)

question:
The inherent filtration of an X-ray tube is a function of:
X선관의 고유 여과는 무엇의 함수인가?
options: A. the thickness and composition of the X-ray tube port (X선관 창의 두께와 재질)
B. the voltage setting of the instrument (장비 전압 설정)
C. the source-to-object distance (선원과 시험물 거리)
D. the material used as a target (표적 재질)

question:
X-ray films with large grain size:
큰 입자를 가진 X선 필름은?
options: A. will produce radiographs better definition than small grain film (작은 입자 필름보다 선명도가 좋다)
B. have slower speeds than those with small grain size (작은 입자보다 속도가 느리다)
C. have higher speeds than those with small grain size (작은 입자보다 속도가 빠르다)
D. will take longer to expose properly (적정 노출 시간이 더 길다)

question:
As the effective energy of the radiation increases up to about 250KV:
방사선 유효 에너지가 약 250KV까지 증가하면?
options: A. film graininess increases (필름 입도 증가)
B. film graininess decreases (필름 입도 감소)
C. radiographic definition increases (방사선 사진 선명도 증가)
D. film speed decreases (필름 속도 감소)

question:
A general rule governing the application of geometric principles of shadow formation states that:
그림자 형성 기하학 원리의 일반적인 법칙은?
options: A. X-ray should proceed from as large a focal spot as possible
B. distance between radiation source and material should be as small as practical
C. film should be as far as possible from the object
D. central ray should be as nearly perpendicular to film as possible

question:
The X-ray absorption of a specimen depends on:
시험물의 X선 흡수는 무엇에 의존하는가?
options: A. thickness and density of material (재질의 두께와 밀도)
B. atomic number of material (재질의 원자번호)
C. both A and B above (A와 B 모두)
D. neither A nor B (둘 다 아님)

question:
The radiographic absorption of a material will tend to become less dependent upon composition when:
재료의 방사선 흡수가 조성에 덜 의존하는 경우는?
options: A. the kilovoltage is increased (전압 증가)
B. source-to-film distance is decreased (선원-필름 거리 감소)
C. kilovoltage is decreased (전압 감소)
D. a filter is used (필터 사용)

question:
The formula (milliampere × time) ÷ distance² is:
(M × T) / D² 공식은?
options: A. used to calculate film gradient (필름 기울기 계산)
B. the reciprocity law (상호 법칙)
C. used to determine radiographic contrast (방사선 명암 결정)
D. the exposure factor (노출 인자)

question:
The load that can be handled by an X-ray tube focal spot is governed by:
X선관 초점이 처리 가능한 부하는 무엇에 의해 결정되는가?
options: A. composition of the cathode (음극 재질)
B. size of focal spot and efficiency of anode cooling system (초점 크기와 양극 냉각 효율)
C. distance from anode to cathode (양극-음극 거리)
D. high-voltage waveform (고전압 파형)

question:
A lead sheet containing a pinhole may be placed halfway between the X-ray tube and film in order to:
핀홀이 있는 납판을 X선관과 필름 중앙에 설치하는 목적은?
options: A. determine the approximate size of the focal spot (초점 크기 결정)
B. measure intensity of central ray (중앙선 강도 측정)
C. filter scatter radiation (산란 방사선 여과)
D. soften X-radiation (X선 연화)
